$comment: Balancing targets the reports check (min/max). Shares are fractions (0.45 = 45 %), times are seconds. Proposed 2026-11-15, change them here when the design changes. Path targets (path*) agreed with Ilja 2026-11-16.

fightSeconds.what: average fight length in every round

longestFight.what: longest fight of a round (one minute of waiting at speed ×1 is too long)

supernovaReached.what: share of fights that reach the Supernova, every round

supernovaLasts90.what: nine in ten Supernova fights are over this many seconds after it starts

heroWinShare.what: win share of every hero, overall and in each third of the run

recipeLift.what: how much more often a hero wins while holding a recipe result than the same hero in the same round without it

recipeMadeShare.what: share of a hero's runs that make the same recipe result (one chain everyone takes)

pathHeroWinShare.what: win share of the hero over all its bots (paths and open) against other heroes

pathWinShare.what: win share of every path, all rounds

pathLateWinShare.what: win share of every path in the last third of the run

pathOverOpen.what: every path wins at least this much more often than the hero's open bot (no path), so following a path pays

pathSpread.what: gap between the hero's best and weakest path, all rounds
